AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Recording Compressor encodes video and audio on this device with FFmpeg or Media3 and can combine a picture or video with a soundtrack. Operational Patterns: - Call describeCapabilities first to learn allowed enum values and whether library access is granted. - If library access is off, ask the user to enable Device library access in Settings and choose Allow all. - Use listDeviceMedia then importDeviceMedia (content URI, path, or file name) to open a file already on the device. - Use getJob, updateJobSettings, or applyPreset to customize a job that is not queued or running. - Use previewEncode, then startJob or startReadyJobs. - Use getQueue, getProgress, and getEncodeLog to monitor work. Use cancelJob or cancelQueue to stop it. Constraints: - Do not record the screen, delete gallery files, or wipe history. - Do not return or request media bytes. Job records omit source and output URIs. - Extra FFmpeg arguments cannot add inputs, paths, or filter_complex.
